display.title: Berry Picking

lines: Good. The bushes will still be sharp when you return.
Put Berry Picking aside for now?

abandoned: I will set the berry baskets aside. Come back if supper still needs them.
abandoned_cooldown: I will pause the berry count for now. Let the kitchen reset before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then the berry-picking request is closed for good.
unavailable: There are no berry baskets here for me to mark abandoned.

lines: Then keep the berries unbruised until you are ready.
Berry Picking is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Berry Picking is complete. The village can use this, and you have earned the reward.
inactive: The kitchen is not accepting berries right now.
missing_objectives: Berry Picking is still short. The tracker has the exact count.
missing_proof: Berry Picking still needs the sweet berries in your pack before I can close it.
missing_target: Berry Picking is not at the right count yet; bring the rest before turning it in.
unavailable: This berry count is not ready to close yet.

lines: Fair. The bushes will keep their little knives for now.
A few sweet berries would make the next ration day feel less like punishment.

responses.label: I can fill the berry baskets

inactive: The berry request has gone quiet for the moment.
reminder: Berry Picking: I still need the sweet berries. Bring the full count back to me.
unavailable: That berry basket count is not yours right now.

already_completed: The berry baskets are already settled.
locate_failed: Berry Picking cannot be posted from here right now.
started: Berry Picking is yours now. Bring the sweet berries back when the count is ready.
unavailable: The kitchen is not asking you for berries right now.

lines: If you have the sweet berries, we can settle Berry Picking.
Keep the berries from bruising, then bring the baskets back to me.
